title: Trump's torment: From draining the swamp to drowning in mid-terms?
content: As Americans head to the polls for the pivotal midterm elections, the stakes couldn't be higher for Trump's administration. Current polling trends indicate a potential shift towards Democratic control in Congress, which could complicate Trump's legislative agenda. Historically, presidents facing an opposing Congress have encountered significant roadblocks, underscoring the potential for ongoing investigations and contentious budget negotiations.

title: '24 hours have passed, Modi ji': Rahul dares PM again for debate - watch
content: Rahul Gandhi has extended a challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for an open debate on several allegations. He outlined topics including foreign influence, the Adani case, and financial matters that require discussion. Rahul gandhi further suggested that the debate take place in the presence of media and youth, proposing Mohan Bhagwat as a moderator.

title: Footballer’s death: What next for goalie? Sanctions, possible criminal proceedings
content: In a devastating turn of events, Jesús de Miguel, a striker for Tenerife, tragically died following an on-field accident with Jesús Owono, the goalkeeper of FC Andorra. The incident, which led to a cardiac arrest for de Miguel during the match, ended in a 2-2 draw, but Owono was issued a red card for his involvement.

title: Billionaire Mark Cuban to Gen Z: Listen to Jeff Bezos’ advice; just get a job
content: Mark Cuban advises young workers to seek any job to gain practical experience and manage workplace expectations. Both Cuban and Jeff Bezos believe that initial employment develops valuable skills like responsibility and teamwork. They highlight the importance of understanding how businesses operate and contributing to productivity. Early jobs can serve as stepping stones for future career advancement and personal growth in professional settings.

title: Quincy Jones tops 2026 highest-paid dead celebrities list with $150m
content: Quincy Jones departed from this world in November 2024, but his legacy thrived, bringing in substantial revenue well into 2026. Much of this financial success stemmed from a remarkable $150 million deal for his extensive music catalog. Additionally, his enduring relationship with Michael Jackson fueled renewed interest following a blockbuster biopic's release.

title: ISSF World C'ships: India’s men win pistol team gold, women’s rifle trio bags silver
content: India celebrated a successful day at the ISSF World Championships by winning a gold medal and two silver medals. The men's 50m pistol team achieved gold with a combined score of 1,659, outperforming their competitors. In the women's 10m air rifle team event, India secured a silver medal with a total of 1,894.4 points. Elavenil Valarivan qualified for the individual finals, aiming for an Olympic quota place.

title: 'Radical thinking': INDIA bloc allies snub Neha Bora's 'Brahmanvaad' remark
content: Neha Bora has been actively involved in protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. She took part in an October 10 demonstration organised by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and student groups in Delhi. Police detained several protesters, including Bora, as restrictions on public gatherings were imposed in parts of the capital.

title: Houston's 132-year-old Kirby mansion demolished, may become gas station
content: Houston's historic Kirby Mansion, a Tudor Revival gem, was abruptly leveled after city inspectors stopped renovation efforts over permit issues. Despite being well-maintained, the new owner proceeded with the demolition unauthorized, leading to outcry from preservationists. The community mourned the mansion with a vigil, pressing for policy reforms and alluding to a gas station development that might replace the beloved site.

title: Punjabi singer turns family farm's saag into Rs 6,000 daily profit
content: Gurmukh Singh, hailing from the quaint village of Ghasiwala, has combined his love for agriculture and entrepreneurship by selling homegrown saag from his family's farm. What started as a modest operation with just 15 packets has blossomed into a daily production of 125 packets sold at Mata Modi Chowk in Sunam. Juggling music and business, Gurmukh uses social media to share his inspiring journey, encouraging others to follow their dreams.

title: US charges 13 Brazilians, Cubans for fake Florida immigration firm; what docs show
content: Thirteen individuals from Brazil and Cuba have been charged in Florida for operating a fake immigration services firm. Legacy Imigra Solutions LLC allegedly provided false legal advice and falsified immigration documents to clients. The accused also conspired to commit marriage fraud and unlawfully employed unauthorized immigrants. If convicted, serious penalties of imprisonment, including up to 20 years, await the defendants.

title: UK couple spends 8 years building garden railway with 400m track and 5 trains
content: Dave and Angela Walker, a couple from Clacton-on-Sea, dedicated eight years to building a miniature railway. Their project spans approximately 400 metres throughout their quarter-acre garden, showcasing various collected memorabilia. Despite opinions from others, they find joy in their shared achievement and partnership. The couple plans to open their railway for community fundraising events benefiting the local lifeboat station.

title: Watch: Ballon d'Or winner Kane makes Kohli admission after 'starstruck' question
content: Harry Kane revealed that Virat Kohli was among several sporting icons who congratulated him on winning the 2026 Ballon d’Or. The England captain also received messages from David Beckham and Tom Brady, both of whom he admires. Kane said Kohli’s message was particularly special, highlighting the mutual respect between the football and cricket stars.

title: Why neither MAGA nor Democrats are particularly bothered about Indian-Americans
content: About 133 years ago, a man born Narendranath said he was from India and preached tolerance at the World’s Parliament of Religions in a speech that evokes awe even today. It’s sad that, so many years later, Americans of all stripes have become particularly intolerant towards his descendants.

title: Matthew Stafford, wife Kelly's net worth: NFL earnings, podcast and luxury homes
content: Matthew Stafford has built an impressive net worth estimated at approximately $180 million from his successful career in the NFL. His earnings have been primarily generated through various contract negotiations during his time on the field. While the financial position of his wife, Kelly Stafford, remains uncertain, they have made noteworthy real estate investments and recently sold properties for modest gains.

title: SSC GD final answer key 2026 released; download response sheet
content: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published the final answer key for the GD Constable and Rifleman recruitment examination 2026. Candidates can access their question papers, recorded responses and examination marks through ssc.gov.in using their login credentials. The download window will remain open until November 17, 2026, at 5 PM. Candidates must save their documents before the deadline.

title: Dead monkey contaminates hostel water tank at Guwahati college; 43 students fall ill
content: Forty-three students at Assam Engineering College fell ill after consuming contaminated water from a hostel tank. The water was contaminated by a monkey's carcass that was discovered in the tank. Following the incident, students experienced minor illnesses, prompting medical attention from local healthcare facilities. The college administration responded by cleaning and disinfecting the tank while relocating students to another hostel.

title: Middle East conflict hits Saudi football: SPL postpones matches after Asian Cup delay
content: The Saudi Pro League (SPL) has announced that Matchweek 13 will be postponed following the rescheduling of the AFC Asian Cup, which is now set for December 2027 to January 2028 due to prevailing security concerns. This alteration affects many Saudi clubs, including Al-Nassr, where Cristiano Ronaldo plays, leading to interruptions in their international fixtures. The SPL intends to reassess its match schedule promptly amid rising tensions in the region.

title: 'Far from reaching a deal': Iran says it wouldn't tolerate 'excessive demands' of US
content: Ongoing negotiations between Iran and the United States aim to de-escalate tensions and address Tehran's conditions. For the past eight days, Qatar has played a pivotal role in mediating the discussions. Despite recent defensive strikes by the US on Iranian targets and a strong military response from Iran, both sides exhibit determination to resolve conflicts through continuous dialogue and mediation, emphasizing the importance of Washington fulfilling Iranian demands.

title: Up 53 spots! Vaishnavi Sharma makes giant leap in ICC ODI rankings
content: India's women cricket team displayed unmatched dominance by sweeping the three-match ODI series against Zimbabwe. Vaishnavi Sharma shone brightly, capturing nine wickets and climbing the bowling rankings. Meanwhile, players like Sayali Satghare and Pratika Rawal also saw boosts in their standings following stellar performances. Even Zimbabwe’s Modester Mupachikwa secured a higher rank.

title: Dia Mirza's video, a 'Hindutva' retort, BMC's move & HC's order; how row unfolded
content: The Bombay High Court has slammed the “petty mindset” behind the Dia Mirza video row, expressing “deep pain and displeasure.” Taking suo motu cognisance, the bench ordered the BMC to re-upload her eco-friendly Diwali clip, calling its removal a knee-jerk reaction after BJP leaders attacked the actor, and stressing everyone breathes the same air.

title: How Indian-Americans may vote in 2026 US midterms: Explained in 5 charts
content: Donald Trump’s second-term policies have triggered a backlash among Indian-Americans, with immigration, economic concerns and relations with India emerging as important fault lines ahead of the midterms. But a resurgent Democratic preference does not necessarily mean the community has returned to its old partisan loyalties.

title: Gujarat horror: 2 farm labourers burnt alive inside vehicle over Rs 30,000 dispute
content: In the early hours, two farm labourers were killed when a vehicle was set on fire in Amreli. The victims, aged 16 and 21, were sleeping inside the van when it was ignited. Authorities arrested two suspects believed to have committed the act over a payment dispute related to the vehicle. Both suspects had allegedly filled cans with petrol prior to the incident.

title: Republicans feel the blues as US midterms begin: Key races and faces to watch
content: Current polling trends show that Republicans might encounter difficulties during the midterm elections on November 3, largely due to dissatisfaction among voters. This election is being viewed as a crucial test of the government's performance on vital topics including the economy and immigration. As both House and Senate races remain hotly contested, the results are far from certain, with Democrats aspiring to take advantage of this discontent.

title: 100 billion times smaller than atom, scientists explore 'zeptoverse'
content: Scientists at the University of Cambridge have made a significant discovery related to particle physics. They detected evidence of a rare process involving beauty quarks using the Large Hadron Collider. This discovery allows researchers to explore interactions at a scale around one zeptometre, known as the 'zeptoverse'. Understanding these interactions could lead to insights about dark matter and its unknown particles.

title: India vs New Zealand 1st ODI: Will rain interrupt Auckland match?
content: India and New Zealand will begin their five-match ODI series at Auckland’s Eden Park on November 4. Rain chances stand at 56% during the morning, but clearer afternoon conditions offer hope for an uninterrupted match. Temperatures are expected to range between 17°C and 19°C. The batting-friendly pitch could favour a high-scoring contest. The match starts at 7:30 AM IST.

title: Sensex ends over 1,200 points up, Nifty50 crosses 23,800: Top 5 reasons for rally
content: Stock market rally today: BSE Sensex ended the day at 76,917.85, up 1,225 points or 1.62%. Nifty50 closed at 23,810.85, up 370 points or 1.58%. The rally added nearly Rs 4 lakh crore to the combined market capitalisation of companies listed on the BSE, taking the total to Rs 486 lakh crore.

title: From juice vendor to 200-crore Dubai wedding: Rise & fall of Mahadev betting boss
content: Sourabh Chandrakar, who previously operated a juice shop, transformed into an online betting syndicate head. He allegedly managed Mahadev Online Book, an illegal betting empire that expanded internationally. Following his extravagant wedding costing Rs 200 crore, investigators intensified scrutiny of his operations. After being located in Oman, he was extradited to India for legal proceedings. His case raises significant questions about money laundering and political involvement in Chhattisgarh.

title: 'Past players will start to go at them': Ex-England cricketer warns Australia
content: Former England cricketer Michael Atherton has urged England to "keep the pressure on Australia" during their upcoming white-ball series, warning that the hosts could "implode" before the 2027 Ashes. Australia are struggling after losing 2-1 to South Africa, with batting concerns and selection questions. David Warner has also criticised their poor performances, while key pacers will miss the England series.

title: Gold, silver lose their shine: Buy now, wait or invest elsewhere this Dhanteras?
content: As Dhanteras nears, Indian consumers are closely monitoring the recent drop in gold and silver prices, scrutinizing how this volatility might influence future values. Financial experts advise buyers to assess their personal needs and investment objectives before making any purchases. With more price changes anticipated in the months ahead, a gradual buying approach is recommended to handle potential risks effectively, ensuring that purchases reflect one's investment philosophy.

title: 'Very small issue': Fadnavis says Dia Mirza video row not at his level
content: In response to the controversy over the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's removal of Dia Mirza's Diwali firecracker awareness video, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stated that the BMC has the authority to manage its social media postings. This remark comes after the Bombay high court ordered the video's re-upload following objections from political leaders that led to its initial deletion.

title: Andhra chainsaw attack: Accused loses right leg; schoolgirl taken off ventilator
content: A Class 10 schoolgirl is recovering in a Bengaluru hospital after being injured in a brutal chainsaw attack. The attacker, Hemanth, had to undergo an emergency amputation following police gunfire in self-defense. Medical teams are optimistic about the girl’s recovery as she is off ventilator support and beginning to respond. Hemanth remains in police custody while receiving treatment for his injuries in a government hospital.

title: India-Pakistan WC clash draws 84 lakh ticket requests for 34,000 capacity stadium

title: Watch: Bengaluru man glues receptionist’s hands to desk, flees with gold
content: On October 31, a masked robber stormed into a shoe and bag repair shop in Indiranagar, brandishing a knife and demanding valuables from Jayashree, the receptionist. Despite the terrifying experience, she bravely yelled for help and managed to escape his grip. Quick action from bystanders led to the swift arrest of Prabhuraj. Authorities are now probing his background, suspecting mental health issues may be involved.

title: 'Punching below its weight': Air India CEO vows to turn around airline profitability
content: Air India is set to bolster its international reach by expanding orders for wide-body aircraft. CEO Tewolde Gebremariam remains optimistic about returning to profitability soon, despite the challenges of losses and escalating costs. The airline has initiated fleet renewal and adopted cost-saving strategies. Key hurdles include effective cost management and the rebalancing of hubs and networks.

title: US university to celebrate first-generation students on November 5: What's planned?
content: Southwest Minnesota State University in the US is preparing to host its third annual First Gen Student Day on November 5, 2026, to celebrate students who are the first in their families to attend college. The event will feature interactive activities, tie-dye sessions and poster presentations showcasing student, employee and alumni experiences. Through the initiative, the university aims to recognise first-generation students' achievements, encourage campus connections and highlight the importance of creating a supportive higher education environment.

title: US midterms: Trump repeats ‘total fraud’ claim over Alaska Senate race as America votes
content: the midterm elections will determine control of congress for the final two years of president Donald Trump’s term . the results could also shape debates within both parties over the policies and messages that resonate with voters ahead of the 2028 presidential election .

title: The Texas test: Latino voters could make or break Trump's midterms
content: Latino voters are emerging as one of the most closely watched constituencies in the US midterm elections . their choices in Texas and beyond could influence the outcome of key races . a shift in their support could have consequences for the closely contested Senate and gubernatorial races, as well as several competitive House districts .
